name: AskHemant 03 · DEMO Skyline Realty · AI qualifier on inbound WhatsApp (DEMO – fictional business)

nodes.name: Meta verification (GET)
nodes.notes: Meta App → WhatsApp → Configuration → Callback URL = this Production URL; Verify token = the value of WA_VERIFY_TOKEN.

nodes.name: WhatsApp events (POST)
nodes.notes: Answers 200 at once (Meta retries slow webhooks). Subscribe the app to the "messages" field.

nodes.name: Config

assignments.name: business_profile
assignments.value: Skyline Realty (DEMO – fictional business) is a small brokerage that helps people buy apartments, villas and plots. An agent confirms prices, availability and possession dates personally. Site visits run Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm.

nodes.notes: DEMO – fictional business. The model id lives here (ai_model). The system prompt is in the "Build Claude request" node and in prompts/real-estate-qualifier.md.

nodes.name: Verify + extract message
nodes.notes: Checks X-Hub-Signature-256 with WA_APP_SECRET, ignores status callbacks and reactions, and returns the lead's message as plain text.

nodes.name: Build Claude request
nodes.notes: System prompt real-estate-qualifier v1.0.0. Source of truth: automations/prompts/real-estate-qualifier.md. Opt-outs, paused chats, numbers outside the DEMO safety list, repeat deliveries (message ids already in history_json) and late deliveries outside the 24-hour window never reach the model.

nodes.name: Claude: qualify lead
nodes.notes: Anthropic Messages API. Credential: Header Auth, name x-api-key. Structured output (JSON schema) so the reply is always parseable.

nodes.name: Parse AI reply + decide
nodes.notes: Code, not the model, decides handover, the agent alert (once per lead), opt-out and the fallback reply.

nodes.name: WhatsApp: send reply
nodes.notes: Free-form text: allowed because the lead messaged within the last 24 hours.

nodes.name: Alert decision

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $('Parse AI reply + decide').first().json;
return [{ json: { alert: d.alert === true, alert_payload: d.alert_payload } }];

nodes.notes: Carries the decision past the Sheets node, so the next nodes read plain $json.

nodes.name: WhatsApp: hot-lead alert to agent
nodes.notes: Utility template "agent_hot_lead_alert" with the summary and the site-visit booking link.

parameters.jsCode: return $('Parse AI reply + decide').first().json.transcript.map((t) => ({ json: t }));

nodes.name: Log transcript (Demo_Conversations)
nodes.notes: Every turn, with model and prompt_version, for the human review of the first 100 conversations.
